scope: Recorded proposal activation on captured live input only, not host execution or strength. 8 boards of four live Deity Korea Science (Online) games (civvis-20261105T131016Z, 124217Z, 100942Z, 103825Z), each the run's events.jsonl cut at frame 0 of a turn where the city holding our Government Plaza listed its next Science tier building (BUILDING_GOV_WIDE or BUILDING_GOV_SPIES) among the host's buildable items while producing routine work. Both arms run one frozen civvis_orders --resumed built from the branch at 7a194bb89 with the run's own requested genome (summary.json forced, each as --with); the on arm adds --with plaza-serves-the-scientist-2. Off arms with no produce order for the tier building: 8/8; on arms producing it in the Plaza city: 7/8 (the eighth, 131016Z t101, held behind a Settler the board wanted next, which the gene never displaces).
